arch/arm/lib/backtrace-clang.S: * store current registers(r0 - r15) value into r0.
* @r0: address of pt_regs to store registers.
arch/arm/kernel/entry-armv.S: @ common_invalid - generic code for failed exception (re-entrant version of handlers)
add	r0, sp, #S_PC		@ here for interlock avoidance
@  r6 - orig_r0 (see pt_regs definition in ptrace.h)
str	r7, [r0, #12]	@ save r7, r8 to detect stack overflow
cmp	r8, #400	@ check 400 bytes available on stack or not.
cmp	r8, #200	@ check 200 bytes available on stack or not.
9998:				@ Fault Address point to Stack pointer
@ and it hits Gaurd Page or going to hit
@ if less than 100 bytes reamin on stack.
tst	r8, #_TIF_VM_STACK + _TIF_VM_KTHREAD	@ check if extra stack is already mapped.
@ or if kernel thread, already 8 KB.
str	r7, [r0, #12]	@ save r7, r8 to detect stack overflow
tst	r8, #_TIF_VMAP_STACK_ALLOC	@ check if extra stack mapping requested.
mrc	p15, 0, r7, c6, c0, 0   @ Read Data Fault Address Register
cmp	r8, #200	@ check 200 bytes available on stack or not.
9998:				@ Fault Address point to Stack pointer
@ and it hits Guard Page or going to hit
@ if less than 200 bytes reamin on stack.
str	r9, [r0, #20]	@ save r9 to handle stack overflow.
tst	r8, #_TIF_VM_STACK + _TIF_VM_KTHREAD	@ check if extra stack is already mapped.
@ or if kernel thread, already 8 KB.
THUMB(	ldr	r5, [sp, #S_PSR]	)	@ potentially updated CPSR
svc_exit r5, irq = 1			@ return from exception
add	r0, sp, #S_PC		@ here for interlock avoidance
str	r3, [sp]		@ save the "real" r0 copied
@ We are now ready to fill in the remaining blanks on the stack:
@  r4 - lr_<exception>, already fixed up for correct return/restart
@  r6 - orig_r0 (see pt_regs definition in ptrace.h)
@ Also, separately save sp_usr and lr_usr
THUMB(	store_user_sp_lr r0, r1, S_SP - S_PC	)
@ Enable the alignment trap while in kernel mode
ATRAP( mcrne	p15, 0, r8, c1, c0, 0)
